articles.title: Scarborough car crash sends 5 people to hospital
articles.summary: Five people were sent to a hospital, one in critical condition, on Saturday afternoon following a two-vehicle crash in Scarborough. Emergency crews were called to the area of Sheppard Avenue East and Kennedy Road just before 1:15 p.m. Authorities say the drivers remained at the scene and that five people sustained injuries. articles.title: Ontario Honda Dealers Indy in Markham underway after Friday cancellation
articles.summary: David Malukas posted the fastest practice lap at the Ontario Honda Dealers Indy at Markham.

articles.title: Toronto police searching for hit-and-run driver who fled early morning car crash
articles.summary: Toronto police were called The Junction neighbourhood early Saturday morning for reports of a hit-and-run crash that left several vehicles damaged. articles.summary: A man has died following a motorcycle crash on Highway 401 in Pickering early Saturday morning. articles.title: Man, 22, from Scarborough dead following single-vehicle crash in Pickering: OPP
articles.summary: Provincial police say a 22-year-old man is dead after a single-vehicle collision involving a motorcycle in Pickering, Ont., overnight Saturday.

articles.summary: Toronto police are investigating two separate stabbings that occurred on Friday evening. articles.title: Toronto clinic brings psychiatrist care closer to new mothers
articles.summary: A clinic in Toronto's east end is making it easier for new mothers to access mental health support quickly. The Midwives’ Clinic of East York-Don Mills, in partnership with Michael Garron Hospital, has opened the first midwifery clinic in the province that offers access to an on-site psychiatrist. articles.title: Mississauga man, 36, faces new charges in human trafficking investigation, police say
articles.summary: A Mississauga man accused of human trafficking is facing additional charges after two more alleged victims came forward, Toronto police say.

articles.title: Mississauga’s mayoral race is neck and neck, poll suggests
articles.summary: The race for becoming Mississauga’s next mayor is currently a coin toss between former mayor Bonnie Crombie and current mayor Carolyn Parrish, a new poll suggests.

articles.title: First practice day at Ontario Honda Dealers Indy in Markham cancelled
articles.summary: The first day of practice and qualifying at the Ontario Honda Dealers Indy at Markham has been cancelled because incomplete track.

articles.title: Stellantis is considering closing and selling Brampton assembly plant, Unifor says
articles.summary: A national union says it was told by Stellantis this week that it is seriously considering the closure and sale of the Brampton assembly plant. In a statement, Stellantis said its focus remains on finding a sustainable manufacturing solution for the plant.

articles.title: Toronto police asking public to help fully ID suspect in 2022 fatal Scarborough shooting
articles.summary: Toronto police partially identified a man named Jay as the suspect in a 2022 Scarborough parking lot shooting that killed a man.

articles.title: What to expect as IndyCar gets underway in Markham
articles.summary: It’s about to get loud in Markham. The city is playing host to the NTT IndyCar Series — among other motorsports series — this weekend for the Ontario Honda Dealers Indy.
